question: On what basis are twenty-one forms said to be distinguished?
premises: A count of twenty-one is declared.
Difference of desire is given as a basis.
This distinction is presented as authoritative.
inference: Twenty-one forms are declared according to differences of desire.
uncertainties: The entities being counted as twenty-one are not named in this verse.
plain_english: And twenty-one are declared, also according to differences of desire.
